title: A Storm of Swords
author: George R.R. Martin
summary: The third volume of A Song of Ice and Fire, set in a continent riven by rival claimants to a throne while a colder threat gathers in the far north. Many viewpoint characters are scattered across the land and facing harsh consequences.
readIf: you want sprawling, unsparing fantasy politics and are already hooked on the first two books.
skipIf: you want a gentle read or a standalone story, or you haven't read earlier volumes.

pairings.reason: A grim, funny, character-first fantasy in which nobody is quite what they seem and violence has real cost.
Real court intrigue with the same pleasure in watching a clever person survive dangerous power games, minus the magic.
Matches the war-and-politics focus but turns the brutality up considerably as it follows one young soldier.
